103)ku sā li'i nyams byung gi gnas tshul mdor bsdus rdo rje'i spun gyis dris lan mos pa'i lam bzang bzhugs so:104)e ma ho:chos sku'i zhing na sta

tei:div.tei:p: 103) ku sā li'i nyams byung gi gnas tshul mdor bsdus rdo rje'i spun gyis dris lan mos pa'i lam bzang bzhugs so: 104) e ma ho: chos sku'i zhing na ston pa kun tu bzang: longs sku'i zhing du rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho: sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po pad+ma 'byung: gdul bya'i khams su 'dren ston chos kyi rje: 'khor lo'i mgon po pad+ma las 'brel la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: bde chen 'khor lor rigs kyi bdag po ru: bzhugs la rab gsal blo gros snang ba stsol: chos sku kun bzang longs sku wā ra hi: sprul sku mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal ma'i: gsung gi thugs sprul rdo rje zhi ba mtsho'i: sgyu 'phrul 105)tsam du sngon byon skyes chen 'gas: rdo rje'i zhal lung rnams su gsal mod kyang: kho mo rang ni skye lus dman pa dang: shes rab chung zhing tha mal pa yi gzugs: thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan cung zad med: le lo g.yeng ba'i dmag gis rgyun du mnar: de 'dra'i lus dman skye ngan bdag lta bur: legs bshad yon tan 'byung tshul gsang ba'i gtam: nam mkha'i pad+mo'i dpe bzhin kun la gsal: 'on kyang rdo rje'i mched po rnam gnyis kyis: gsung bskul nan cher phebs pa mi ldog tsam: sngon bsags bsod nams mthu las 'khrungs pa yi: legs bshad gnas 106) tshul cung zhig 'di na spro: dbyings spyod ḍā ki'i tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol: sngon tshe thub pa'i spyan sngar ut+pal ma: rgya gar yul du ro langs bde rol dang: pad+ma'i drung du rdo rje zhi ba mtsho: li yi yul du bal mo byang chub sgron: de nas rim brgyud bod yul lha ldan du: kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mo bdag: rigs bzang 'byor ldan wang gi rigs las chad: chung nas chos la mos shing byang sems ldan: chos brgyad bya bar snying po med mthong nas: rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab: de'i mthus lo brgyad dus su mkha' 'gro mas:

rjes bzung byin brlabs gces pa'i bu bzhin bskyangs: rje btsun sgrol ma dge ma'i gzugs sprul nas: bdag rjes bzung ste sems bskyed bslab bya mdzad: kun dga' 'bum mas skyabs sdom la sogs kyi: chos kyi sgor btsud thar pa'i lam ston mdzad: pha ma rigs bzang chos la blo dkar yang: thob kyis len pa dpon gyi rigs yin phyir: lugs gnyis 'dres mar spyod pa'i chas su ni: zhugs nas lo shas 'bangs sde g.yog 'khor bskyangs: pha yis bka' phebs khyim pa'i gnas lam bstan: 107)shin tu bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar bas: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis pad 'byung mtsho rgyal dang: dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la: gsol btab mthu yis 'khor ba'i rkyen las bzlog: bcu gnyis dus su las kyi rigs sad nas: sa ra ha pas rjes bzung smin grol gyi: lam bstan 'khor lo bzhi pa'i man ngag skor: gdams pa tshang sprugs gces nor tshul du bslab: sbyangs pas rtsa rlung sgrib pa cung zad srab: rtags drug zhugs gnas thim pa'i drod tshad mthong: dngos dang dngos med lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul gyis: rtogs pa'i bogs thon rig pa'i ye shes mjal: snang sems lha 'dre'i gzugs su shar shes nas: rtog pa'i 'dra 'bag sems kyis bcos ma dgos: lha 'dre gdul bya'i tshul du re zhig bskyangs: bcu gsum dus su sngon bsags smon lam mthus: grub pa'i dbang phyug ku ku pa dang mjal: rtsa rlung gegs sel man ngag ngo sprod dang: 'khor lo lnga la brten nas phyi nang gi: phyag rgya'i lam rim gsang ba'i chos rnams bstan: snying gi rtsa mdud grol ba'i mthus bskul nas: ma dang mkha' 'gros brda byang 'chug med sprad: pad 'byung mtsho 108) rgyal rnams kyi zhal dngos mjal: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i pho nyar mnga' gsol nas: 'gro don dus bab yod pa'i lung bstan cing: don gnyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i bslab bya mdzad: mdo khams bdud sde srin po'i yul phyogs su:

grogs dang chos bdag gdul bya de na yod: dman pa'i tshul gyis yul gsum thabs kyis 'dren: zhes sogs lung bstan slab bya du ma mdzad: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gnyis kyi bka' dbang thob: 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur lung bstan brda byang gtad: ma 'ongs 'brel thogs dang bcas mkha' 'gro'i gling: rang snang dag pa'i zhing du 'dren nus zhes: bka' yi zhal tshab brda yi ris su gnang: g.yu sgron ma yis dngos su grogs byas te: 'byung 'gyur brda byang yi ge'i ris su mdzad: khyad par rigs lnga'i sems dpa' brtag thabs dang: 'gugs sbyangs smin pa'i las kyi bslab bya mdzad: rig 'dzin dang ni o rgyan zangs gling dang: mkha' 'gro'i brda sogs yig ris dpe sprad nas: 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur brda yi man ngag gnang: des mthus gzugs med lha 'dre'i 'gro don byung: gnyan chen la sogs bod skyong gzhi bdag gis: mthun rkyen bsgrubs shing gter kha 109)phran bu re: sprad kyang bod khams bde phyir yang gter sbas: de skabs dge slong kun dga' 'bum ma zhes: yin par skad pa'i btsun ma zhig na re: khyod kyis stong pa nyid kyi don e shes: stong pa nyid kyi don de ma rtogs na: lus ngag dge la bskul yang don 'bras chung: gces 'dzin 'ching ba dam pos kun dkris nas: tshe 'dir dge sdig cha mnyam spyad pa yis: 'bras bu mtho ris gsum dang ngan song rnams: res mos spyod cing 'khor ba'i mtha' la gnas: de phyir khyod kyi shes rab mig ma long: blang dor mkhas pas sems kyi gsang chen po: rang la gnas pa'i ye shes nyams su longs: zhes gsungs de la bdag gis 'di skad zhus: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wa ra hi'i: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur rnal 'byor ma: khyed la mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs: bdag la sems kyi gsang ba bstan du gsol: tshe 'dir srid pa 'khor bar mi gnas par: rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs:

zhes zhugs rje btsun ma yis 'di skad gsungs: e ma nyon dang skal ldan sbyangs 'phro can: sems kyi gsang ba'i man ngag bstan pa ni: dang po 110)sgo gsum rnal du dbab byed pa: lus gnad rnam par snang mdzad chos bdun dang: ngag gnad smra bcad rgyud mangs sgra chad ltar: smra bar mi brtson ngag rlung rang sor bzhag: ngo bo stong pa chos sku spros dang bral: gsal ba longs sku rang gsal 'gags pa med: 'phro 'du'i rtsal snang gang shar sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum dbyer med rig pa gzhi la rdzogs: dbang rab rig pa rang snang blo can gyi: spyod yul man ngag 'di nyid mchog tu zab: dbang 'bring dbang po yul gyi blo can la: sgo gsum ru shan nas bzung byung gnas sogs: sems kyi khang bu bshig pa'i man ngag dgos: khyod ni byis pa le lo ma che bar: bdag gis gdams pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams: yal bar ma dor rang rgyud lon par mdzod: stong nyid lta ba zer yang de las med: sku gsum rig pa zer yang de ka yin: rang byung ye shes chen po de nyid do: de las lhag pa'i sems kyi gsang ba ni: stong gsum kun tu btsal kyang rnyed mi 'gyur: rang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos yin phyiraḥ sangs rgyas zhes pa gzhan du ma tshol ang: de 111)skad gsungs nas nam mkhar 'ja' ltar yal: bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin nyams len la: shi mthar thug gi bar du brtson par chad: rang lo bcu bzhi nas bzung bco brgyad bar: chos phyir lus dang ngag gi dka' ba spyad: zla ba re tsam zas kham gcig med kyang: chos min bya ba bdag gis byas pa med: chung nas bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang ni: lhag pa'i lha la blo gtad ling gis bkal: sdug bsngal bzod dka' ci dang ci byung yang: thams cad rang gis sngon bsags las yin bsam: tshe 'dir dam chos rnam dag zhig med na: spyir na sems can dgos su pha ma yi: drin chen drin lan bdag gis 'khor thabs bral: bsam zhing rang yul srin po'i gling 'dra ba:

spangs nas dka' spyad snying rus chen po yis: mdo smad shar phyogs mgo log yul gling du: sngon gyi smon lam las 'phro'i stobs kyis 'phangs: rang nyid lus dman longs spyod dbul ba yis: 'gro ba kun gyis brnyas dmod sna tshogs byed: zab pa sa yi gter la dbang na yang: grogs dang chos bdag gzhan rkyen sab+tas bsgyur: de ltar rkyen ngan du mas 112)mnar ba'i tshe: bdag gis dbyings spyod ḍā ki'i dkyil 'khor la: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul nas 'di skad bskul: kye ma kyi hud ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams: thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzims par: las ngan kho mo bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: ji ltar byas kyang mkha' 'gro'i bka' lung bzhin: bdag gis bstan 'gro'i don de 'byung bar dka': snyigs dus 'gro ba log spyod bdud kyis bslus: chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: dkor nag log 'tsho'i zas la sman bzhin mthong: rang mgo mi thon gzhan mgo g.yo sgyus bskor: gshin po'i ro dom gson po'i dad zas len: las 'bras khyad gsid mid ge sna tshogs spyod: de 'dra'i snyigs dus rang rtags ngoms pa'i tshe: bdag 'dras bstan 'gro'i rgud pa ci'i phyir sel: mi rnams rgyud gyong log lta che ba yis: phar la gces par bskyangs kyang tshur la sdang: chos dang mthun par spyad na glen pa zer: rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bdag bas gzhan gces kyi: bzang ngan ro snyoms bzod pa'i go bgos kyang: bzang ngan mi shes mi ngan khyi 'dra zer: de la sogs pa'i ngan smod sna tshogs kyis: bdag la yon tan med pa'i tshul mthong ste: 113)brnyas dmod log par lta ba'i gzhir gyur pas: 'gro don phar zhog rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu: de phyir bdag gis lus ngan 'di bor nas: chos ldan skyes pa'i lus su bdag smon te: gu ru yab yum thugs bzhed 'grub pa dang: ḍā ki'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gror sman thabs brtson: ye shes dbyings bzhugs rnams kyis da dgongs 'tshal:

ces pa'i 'o dod drag pos 'bod pa'i mthus: dbyings kyi sprul pa dbyings kyi rgyan shar ba: dbyings kyi yum chen dbyings phyug kun gsal mas: dbyings snang ḍā ki'i brda gsang 'di skad ngoms: e e yāḥ shar nam mkha'i nor bu 'od gsal ba: 'gro'i mun pa bsal bar phyogs ris med: ma mkha' 'gros bskul ba'i pho nya la: lus bzang ngan phyogs ris ci la srid: rang gdul zhing smon lam 'phro la rag: khyod thugs ngal skyo sun ma mdzad dang: khyod rang lo brgyad nas bcu bzhi'i bar: sngon pad+ma mtsho skyid smon lam mthus: lha 'dre yi 'gro don cung zad smin: de rang mthong ma che sngon las yin: bco lnga nas nyi shu la babs tshe: las bsdug bsngal bzod dka' du ma myong: 114)yid ma zhums las kyi mtha' ma yin: rtsa gcig nas rtsa brgyad la thug tshe: yul gdul zhing snyigs pa'i rkyen dbang gis: ngan 'brel las bzang 'brel shin tu dkon: blo yid gnyis med par pad 'byung dang: ma mtsho rgyal la gsol 'debs brtson nus na: de phan chad rang skal gter grogs dang: las ldan gyi chos 'dzin dang 'phrad nas: bstan 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'byung: bzang 'brel las ngan 'brel rim gyis nyung: slar bzang ngan gang gis 'brel gyur kyang: de khyod kyi gdul bya'i zhing yin pas: chags sdang dang dga' sdug spyod pa spongs: mnyam nyid kyi rdzong mkhar ma zhan dgos: ma mkha' 'gros mngags pa'i pho nya laḥ rten 'brel gyi chos la rag las pas: thabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyis gzab gal che: rang gter ston e 'ong rang gis shes: dbyings ḍā ki'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrub na: chos gter la dbang yang sab+tas bsgrib: las mi 'dod sna 'dren rang gis byed: khyod gter la dbang yang gzhan rkyen song: chos mi ngor shor nas khyim thabs 'dzin: rang gter gyi bya ba phag tu 115)yibs: las 'di 'dra byed pa a re sdug: ma mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin bsgrub na: khyod tshe 'dir don gnyis 'byung bar nges:

brda go'am rigs ldan gzhon nu ma: nga dbyings kyi sprul pa dbyings su a: zer bar snang zhing dbyings su 'od du yal: bcu drug nas bzung nyi shu rtsa brgyad bar: skyid sdug ma nges chu yi gnyer ma bzhin: byung zhing phyed ka chos kyi phyir dang ni: phyed cha 'jig rten phyogs su sdug bsngal myong: khyad par dbang thob bla ma'i bka' bzhin du: khyim thabs bzung zhing 'khor ba'i bya bar brtson: mi ngo lon pa'i dus ni ngas ma byung: rkyen des bskul nas 'khor bar blo sun te: mi mngon dpal ri'i zhing du 'gro snyam tshe: mi min yul gyi bu mo mdzes ma gnyis: rin chen du mas brgyan cing ngag snyan sgras: e ma gson dang grogs mo: nged gnyis khyod kyis shes sam: mi mngon zhing nas yongs ba'i: bzhin mdzes ḍā ki nged gnyis: khyod la ngag gsal bsgron yong: bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong na: grogs khyod byon na legs bsam: dus ngan mi yi blo sems: bdud dbang gyur pa e nam: grogs la 'thab 116)'khon ma byed: nyams pa'i grib kyi 'tshe bas: khyod la sdang 'ong e nam: mi mo gsal gyi ming can: khyod kyi dge ba'i bskul ma: de la chags sdang spongs la: gang dgar bzhag pa e nam: lho yi lcags sbrul smug chung: sgra brgya'i gtsug tu 'chang na: ring min nye nas don gnyis: nor bu lon pa e nam: da lan nged cag gnas su: khyod bgrod stabs ldan med tshe: cang shes cang shes lo 'dzin : skyes bu de yis bskul nas: badz+ra ming gi mthun rkyen: dus su 'dzom pa e nam: lo gsum zla gsum bar du: mi yi rgyu 'grul spangs nas: sgrub pa nyams len brtson na: mkha' 'gro'i dus tshigs 'chug med: sa ga zla ba'i 'bod pa: phran bu des sel e nam: las dang bya ba gang byed: ḍā ki'i zhal lung ji bzhin: khyod kyis legs par bsgrub na: gter gnyis bstan pa'i ba dan: khyod la dbang ba e nam: dus dang dus su 'byung 'gyur: brda don khyod la smra 'ong:

gzhan la ma smra gsang rgya: tsit+ta'i klong du sba mdzod: ces zer nam mkha'i klong du 'ja' 117)ltar yal: rkyen des 'byung 'dus cung zad 'khrugs pa dang: gter chen karma gling pa'i sprul pa dngos: 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros rin po ches: mkhyen bzhin chos dam gnyan po'i bka' nan gyis: bdag ni mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin 'gro thabs dben: de skabs shig la gu ru yin skad pa'i: paṇ+ḍi ta yi cha byad dge btsun zhig: bdag ni phyugs rdzir yod pa der byon nas: khyod kyis nga ni e shes lan gsum zer: bdag gis smras pa gu ru khyed yin na: dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mngon shes khyed la mnga': mdzad pa bsam yas rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med: dngos grub mchog brnyes 'dren pa kun gyi gtso: bla med bla ma khyed la gus phyag 'tshal: bdag dang bdag la 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag: rje btsun gu ru khyed dang dbyer med par: chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong du byang chub shog: ces gsol dge sbyong zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: nga ni rgyu med rkyen med sprul pa'i sku: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung lhun gyis grub: dge sbyong bdag la 'gro ba'i don las 118)med: lus med lus mchog rdo rje'i sku brnyes phyir: so skye rnams kyis pad 'byung zhal rgyang ring: sngon smon stobs dang mos pas rgyud bskul na: dad pa can gyis pad 'byung dus drug tu: zhal mjal gsung thos dgongs brgyud byin rlabs thob: khyod kyang las 'phro ldan pas nga dang mjal: thabs kyi grogs spangs sngags la the tshom pas: nga nyid tha mal lus can dge sbyong mthong: da ni rang skal gter la spyod 'dod na: 'di nas nyi ma lho phyogs nye cha na: nga min nga dang gnyis med gter spyod mkhan: rdo rje'i rigs can sems dpa' rasmi'i ming: dpa' bo de dang khyod gnyis lhan 'dzom na: lho nas lho ru gter gnyis bstan pa dar:

lcags sbrul nag po 'brug gi lte bar snyan: ngang pa'i khyu tshogs phyogs nas sprin bzhin 'du: kha ta nag pos dug char ma btang na: drug cu'i bar du mtha' dmag dus 'khrug gzhom: bod khams bde skyid nyi ma cung zhig shar: rang gter kha byang bzhin du dus rtags dang: rten 'brel la sogs gnad zab gal che'o: zhes gsungs rkyen des snang ba gnas 'gyur te: dag pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral la slebs nas: ka la ping 119)ka'i brda yi rgyud mangs las: zab gter chos kyi kha byang 'bring po lon: 'phral du bi ma rasmis rjes bzung nas: gangs ri gnyis pa rma chen spom ra yi: nub sgo dbang phyug ma bdun nye 'khor nas: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab gter drangs: gzhan yang smon 'grub a shwa'i mchod sdong dang: lcags ri 'od 'bar dang ni sdong rdzong gnas: khyung drag rtse dang pad+ma ri mtho dang: sprel rdzong la sogs gnas chen gnas phran nas: res 'ga' chos gter res 'ga' rdzas gter bton: de dag rnams kyi skabs su lung bstan sogs: du ma snang yang gdul zhing snyigs rkyen gyis: rten dang 'brel 'byung sab+ta'i dbang du song: dus babs rten 'brel ldan pa'i zab chos ni: dper na chu rdol sa yis mi khegs ltar: rkyen ngan rlung ltar 'tshubs kyang ya nga med: skal ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pa'ang ngang gis 'phrad: chos brgyad bya ba thabs kyis spang nus byung: rtsa dgu nas bzung sum cu rtsa gnyis bar: 'phral gyi rkyen dang sngon gyis las smin nas: grogs kyis dor nas dgos med khyi 120)bzhin phud: mi bzod nad gzhi drag pos rkyen bskul te: skyabs rje 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel pas: rjes bzung smin grol gdams pa'i chos mdzod kyis: bdag blo'i ma rig mun pa drung 'byin nas: shes rab ye shes sgo brgya'i gsang mdzod phyes: thos bsam yon tan nor gyis phyug par mdzad: khyad par nang don ye shes mngon sum du:

sad cing zung 'jug phyag rgya'i grol lam thob: de'i mthus phyi yi gdul zhing snyan grags rgyas: nang du dbu mgrin rtsa yi mdud rgya khrol: gsang ba mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur nas: zab gter bris spel bstan pa ches cher rgyas: 'gro don gdul bya 'bad med ngang gis dar: lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag tshogs: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas mthun rkyen bsgrubs: lung bstan bslab bya gsungs pa gzhan du gsal: skabs shig 'gro 'dul dpa' bo'i bkas bskul nas: khrom gyis stong ra brag dkar nye cha na: gnas bcas yod skabs mi min bu mo bzhi: stag seng dom dang smra mkhas gdong can bzhis: mgrin cig snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad zer: 121)ha ya hi: gson dang rnal 'byor dbang mo: ti gro mkha' 'gro'i rdzong nas: kun gzigs ye shes dbang mos: khyod la ngag gsal bskur yod: gnas mchog rdo rje brag rdzong: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'du rar: zab chos dgongs pa 'dus pa: ḍā ki'i thugs kyi ti ka: dus babs rten 'brel legs pas: ak+ṣa'i dpal du shar ba: dus ni cang shes ngoms dus: nye min ring nas srung mas: khyod la rang gter sprod nges: zab phyir 'tshub lhongs che bas: de la stabs ka gzab dgos: kun gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor: sa 'dzin 'khun pa'i sgra yis: chu 'dzin nag pos bskul nas: gsal byed gzi mdangs nyams srid: de la shes rab ma zhan: snyan snyan tshig gi mdun bsus: mi snying gdon gyis bsgyur nas: mi 'dod yo langs sna tshogs: smra ming 'dzin gyis bskul la: ci cha ci 'gyur ci yod: dus su 'byung 'gyur nges tshig: ḍā ki'i brda gsar ngoms 'ong: e go e go grogs mo: zhes zer lan du bdag gis: khyed cag su yin dris tshe: gtam mjug ma 122)rdzogs gzhan rkyen zhig gis ni: gnyid las sad cing nyams snang rang sar yal: 'on kyang ḍā ki'i brda byang ji bzhin du: zab gter spyan drangs bri spel gsal khyab byas:

de skabs go 'jo'i rgyal po yin skad pa'i: mi nag lwa ba dkar po can zhig gis: 'jigs pa'i ngar skad chen pos 'di skad zer: khyod ni ma nges pa yi bud med zhig: yul 'dir 'og don ci yin gang nas yin: 'di ru ma 'dug 'u cag rtsod pa yong: de bas bde skabs khyod rang yul gzhan song: zhes zer aṃ gtsig bsdam nas zhe sdang ngoms: bdag gis smras pa khyod 'dra'i las ngan gyi: ma nges pa yi mi zhig ngas ma mthong: khram khog 'di ni rgya bod kun gyi lam: khyod rang gcig pur thob pa ngas ma go: 'on kyang nga ni yul dang pha ma med: gcig pur rgyal khams gang bder 'gro ba yin: lus dang longs spyod gces 'dzin bdag la med: las snang 'khrul pa'i lha 'drer 'gyed du btang: gzugs can gzugs med kun la snyems thag chod: gang shar gang snang sems kyi cho 123)'phrul shes: gces 'dzin 'khrul snang bshig pa'i gdams pa yod: glo bur rkyen las khyod 'dra'i yid gzugs shar: phan dang gnod med thams cad chos sku'i rtsal: ye grol skye med yum chen dgongs klong phaṭaḥ ces brjod rig stong mtha' bral chen po'i ngang: dag mnyam dbyings su cung zhig ngal bsos tshe: 'khrul snang rmi lam lta bu dbyings su yal: so gsum nas bzung da la thug gi bar: rang nyid bsod nams chung ba'i rkyen dbang gis: skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa snying gi nor: pad+ma las 'brel mkha' 'gro'i gling du gshegs: kho mo bdag ni mgon med shul du bor: gnas dang grogs med sa mthar spyugs nas kyang: kun gyi mig la tsher ma lta bur gzan: skyabs rje bla ma'i thugs kyi sras gcig pu: rdo rje'i mched po sna tshogs rang grol pas: khyed ni bka' drin can gyi gzungs ma mchog: yin phyir thag ring yul du spyugs re kan: gsungs te chos dam gnyen po dpang bzhag mdzad: rkyen des lo shags ser dgon gnas su bsdad: gter chen yab sras 124) gnyis kyi zab chos rnams:

'dzin skyong spel sogs skyabs rje'i bkas gnang ltar: nye ring kun la zab gter dar rgyas spel: khyad par chos bdag pradz+nyā rasmi'i gtsos: las can rnams la gter gnyis pha phogs gtad: gzhan yang skal ldan grangs las 'das pa yis: zab chos nyams blangs dbain par sgrub tshugs bzung: don gnyis mdzad pas gter gnyis bstan pa bskyangs: skyabs rje bla ma'i yang srid khrir 'khod tshe: bdag gi sems kyi sdug bsngal cung zad zhi: 'on kyang bdag 'dra nor skyong gyi na bar: g.yu ral ldan pa'i seng ge'i ming thogs pa: skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i drin las byung: de don bsam na sems skyo dwangs dus med: kun gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i tshe: skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i sku dkyil dran: 'od kyis phyogs kun mun pa sel ba'i dus: thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i yon tan dran: steng phyogs nam mkha'i klong nas nub rir phyogs: rje nyid bdag cag 'gro ba'i mgon byon nas: gzugs sku mya ngan 'das pa'i bkod pa dran: mkha' klong yangs pa'i dbyings nyid mthong ba'i tshe: gzhi dbyings dag 125)pa chos sku'i klong nyid nas: rang byung lhun grub gzugs sku'i snang ba dran: brda rtags ci dang ci mthong ci shar yang: skyabs rje bla ma yid bzhin nor bu dran: dben dgon gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran: nyams len gdams ngag bsam tshe bla ma dran: gzhung bzang mched grogs mthong tshe bla ma dran: ci dang ci la bsam kyang bla ma dran: 'dren ston pad+ma las 'brel khong rang dran: dran nas dus kun gsal byed chu rgyun 'bebs: blo sems gdung bas skyo nas dran pa 'khrul: rtag tu bsten kyang skad cig yud tsam 'dra: smin grol thob pa mang yang skad cig tsam: 'di 'dra'i bkod pa dran tshe kye ma hud: sku zhal mthong tshe dad mos gting nas skyes: gsung thos tsam gyis smin grol lam sna zin: thugs kyi dgongs pas gsang mdzod sgo brgya 'byed:

'gro ba'i khams dbang dang bstun chos char 'bebs: 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i 'phrang las thar bar mdzad: gtan bde bla med go 'phang mchog brnyes nas: gdod ma'i dbyings su grol ba'i ded dpon mdzad: bka' drin bsam las 'das shing 'khor thabs bral: de don bsam zhing 126)gdung bas rgyud bskul nas: rje btsun bla ma dran pa'i smre sngags shor: 'on kyang bla ma'i sku drin gsab phyir du: rang don yid byed blo ngan rgyang spangs nas: skal ldan rnams la zab gter 'chad spel dang: sgo gsum bya ba chos dang mthun byas te: bse ru lta bur dben par sgrub tshugs bzung: gter la dbang yang gter spyod ngas mi thon: pha chos bu yis 'dzin na des chog snyam: rang gter zab mo sa yi gter gnas ni: sku yi gnas gsum thugs kyi gnas gsum dang: brag dkar gsum dang rdzong gsum sbas gnas gnyis: de dag gter gyis gnas su bshad pa yin: zab pa'i chos kyang rtsa ba sdong po dang: yal ga me tog dang ni 'bras bu'i chos: sa gzhi lta bu'i dgongs pa mi 'gyur gter: phrin las kha tshar gter ni bsam mi khyab: gter gyi grogs kyang mchog gnyis rab gsum dang: rigs lnga'i char gtogs sems dpa' chen po lnga: chos kyi bdag po bka' babs bu bzhi dang: mchog brgyad dang ni nyer lnga brgya rtsa sogs: 'byung nas rim gnyis 'bras bu tshe 'dir lon: chos gter 'byed pa'i dus rtags rten 'brel sogs: 127)kha byang dang ni yang byang snying byang dang: zur byang la sogs skabs don ḍā kis sprad: 'gro don gdul zhing yul lnga khyad par du: shar gyi phyogs dang lho ru dar bar bstan: de ltar rang gter rtsa tshig mdor bsdus 'di: skal bzang bu slob rnams kyi bzhed skong phyir: don che tshegs chung phrin las yig gzugs bkod: tha mal so skye lus dman bdag lta bur: legs bshad gsang ba'i yon tan ci'i phyir snang: 'on kyang brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs rje dang: tshogs gnyis 'bras bur smin pa'i don dam gyis:

skye phreng du mar chos ldan lus thob nas: rigs can rnams kyi thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed: zab gter mnga' bdag pad+ma gling pa yis: rjes bzung smin grol chos kyis dbugs dbyung bas: sngon gyi 'phro sad zab gter phran bur dbang: de nas rim brgyud skye phreng cha shas su: zab mo gter gyis dngos grub phran rer dbang: 'khor slob gdul bya skyong 'dod blo med kyang: smon lam dbang gis gdul bya thabs kyis bskyangs: legs bshad gsang ba'i yon tan cher med kyang: rang gi gnas tshul mdor bsdus phyogs tsam 'di: thob thang chos brgyad sngon bsu byas pa 128)min: skal bzang bu slob rnams kyi zhal ma gcog: brdzun tshig yi ge'i ris su bris pa yi: dge 'dis bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan: phyi nang rten 'brel legs 'grigs bsod nams 'phel: snod bcud yongs kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sel: dmag 'khrugs mu ge'i bskal ngan kun zhi nas: zab gter bstan pa phyogs bcur dar ba dang: der 'dzin skyes bu'i mdzad phrin rgyas par shog: sbyin bdag mnga' thang longs spyod gong 'phel rgyas: sems can bde skyid phun tshogs chos la spyod: kun kyang bdag gi gdul bya'i zhing gyur nas: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du: rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍā kis mdun bsus te: gu ru sid+dhi'i glu dbyangs len bzhin du: pad+ma 'gro 'dul gling dang dbyer med par: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du skyes nas kyang: ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shog: ces pa ku sā li'i nyams byung gi gtam 'di'ang skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du smos na grub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin pa chen po dge legs dpal bzang po'i dngos slob rdo rje'i spun grogs shākya'i dge btsun dam pa rtog bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa don li 129)dang*/ rang byung gnyis nas rin chen gnyis pa dang lha reg dri bral bcas dus ring mo nas nan cher bskul ba dang*/

rang slob bya bral shes rab 'od zer nas kyang zab gter gsum gyi rten bzhengs dang*/ tshe 'dir dben khrod kho nar 'dug cing zab chos 'dzin skyong ci nus byed pa dang: khyad par sgo gsum bla ma'i phyogs su 'bul zhing chos min gyi bya ba ring du spangs nas sgrub pa lhur len byed pa sogs kyis yang yang nan tan chen pos bskul ba dang: gzhan yang rigs bzang 'gyur med phrin las sogs dad ldan bu slob rnams kyis nan cher yang yang bka' bskul zab phyir ma ldog tsam du skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal ba kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos rang lo so brgyad pa sbrul lo'i zla tshes dge bar ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod ljongs nas bris pa yi ge'i mthun rkyen rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes bgyis pa'o// phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing bkra shis sar gyur cig/ sarba maṅga laṃ// 130)
